_meta.scope_note: Registration thresholds for non-established (cross-border) sellers, as monitored by Stripe Tax. US rows are post-Wayfair economic nexus; digital/SaaS taxability varies and is noted per row, not modelled.
_meta.source_note: Amounts and measurement periods are Stripe's published values, which is what a merchant sees in their own Stripe Tax 'Needs attention' tab. Each row also links the underlying tax authority in source_url.
